decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Design and Access statement, 0912-0612-06 Rev D, 0912-0612-05 Rev B, 0912-0612-03 Rev J, 0912-0640-02 Rev A, 0912-0612-01 Rev A. Received: 12th August 2016. 
0912-0612-300 Rev U, Construction Phase Plan, two unnumbered plans showing arrangements during construction. Cycle stand information.  Received: 20th September 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The cycle parking as shown on plan number 0912-0612-300 Rev U received on the 20th September 2016 shall be implemented in strict accordance with the submitted details and shall be implemented before first occupation of the hereby approved extensions. The cycle parking shall be permanently retained thereafter.
Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the submitted Construction Phase Plan received on 20th September 2016.
Condition : 5 - The external staircase hereby permitted shall not be used other than in an emergency or for maintenance purposes.

Condition : 6 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those specified on the plans hereby approved and the application form.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension with associated works
